summary: Looks at the problems of very large private networks that run out of private IPv4 address space, the options available, and the issues in assigning a new block of private IPv4 addresses. It makes no recommendation and simply documents the issues.

eli5.summary: Huge companies can run out of made-up private addresses. This paper lays out the options, like asking for more private numbers, and the problems each choice causes, without picking one.

questions: do we need more private ipv4 address space
rfc 1918 address exhaustion in large networks
